research_integrity: The elementary local-window proof and executable finite checker were checked in the same review process. Finite computations are not proof of convergence. An unlocated broader marked-extreme theorem might cover the finding.
scientific_limitations: Only iid uniform points on the unit interval; the theorem is a joint weak limit, not finite-sample independence, rates or higher-dimensional universality. The first two marginal extreme laws are classical; no independent historical-priority evaluation.
title: Three independent extreme scales in one-dimensional nearest-neighbor geometry
